Provides assistance in the development of reports, presentations, and data analysis. Assists in data collection and provides feedback on study's progress. Recruits subjects to participate in the study by using approved methodologies. Conducts the enrollment of study participants, including explaining research procedures, and obtaining informed consent of subjects and/or their families. Schedules appointments of study participants; conducts reminder phone calls and/or sends mailouts. Reviews the data collection forms for each enrollee for completion and quality; checks work of junior staff performing data entry to ensure timely and accurate entry. Provides technical guidance to junior staff. Conducts literature searches. Assists Investigators with manuscript and presentation preparation and research.
ADMINISTRATIVE
Performs office-related duties such as answering phones, picking up and delivering mail, ordering and distributing office supplies, handling faxes, scanning, filing, photocopying, collating materials, maintaining the update of policy manuals, etc. Perform administrative duties associated with the study's Data Monitoring and Safety Board, tracking and reporting adverse events and collecting data specified by the DSMB. Responsible for all other administrative duties related to research activities. Responsible for the administrative aspects of the research study, including: managing program records and handling communication needs of the program. Prepares and maintains Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals and correspondence, including amendments and renewals as necessary. Obtains and distributes payment vouchers for participant reimbursements/participation.
The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required.

Bachelor's degree required by time of hire; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in clinical research, public health, or working with children and families.
Proven track record in recruiting research subjects, with a solid understanding of the ethical and technical conduct of research.
Exceptional English communication skills (oral and written).
Bilingual candidates with strong command of spoken and written English, Spanish, and/or Haitian Creole preferred.
Deep knowledge of cultural sensitivity and extensive comfort working across a wide range of social, racial, and ethnic populations.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook) and web browsers. Proficiency in statistical software strongly preferred.

cond_0126.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team. The Research Assistant will support research activities using approved techniques, including patient recruitment, administering questionnaires, abstracting medical records, maintaining patient databases, and helping prepare data and reports. The role also involves coordinating with the research team on grant preparation, literature searches, and manuscript writing. There may also be opportunities to assist the principal investigator with translation to Spanish or Haitian Creole and interpreting experimental results.
cond_0126.responsibilities:
Collaborate with the team on the development of reports, presentations, and data analysis.
Support data collection and share feedback on study progress.
Coordinate subject recruitment using approved methodologies.
Conduct enrollment of study participants, including explaining research procedures and obtaining informed consent from subjects and/or their families.
Schedule appointments for study participants; coordinate reminder phone calls and/or mailouts.
Review data collection forms for each enrollee for completion and quality; work with junior staff on data entry to help ensure timely and accurate entry.
Provide technical guidance to junior staff.
Conduct literature searches.
Assist Investigators with manuscript and presentation preparation and research.
ADMINISTRATIVE
Support office-related duties such as answering phones, picking up and delivering mail, ordering and distributing office supplies, handling faxes, scanning, filing, photocopying, collating materials, and maintaining policy manuals.
Coordinate administrative duties associated with the study's Data Monitoring and Safety Board, including tracking and reporting adverse events and collecting data specified by the DSMB.
Share responsibility for all other administrative duties related to research activities.
Help manage program records and handle communication needs of the program.
Prepare and maintain Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals and correspondence, including amendments and renewals as necessary.
Obtain and distribute payment vouchers for participant reimbursements/participation.
The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required.
cond_0126.requirements:
A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required by time of hire.
Prefer experience in clinical research, public health experience or working with children and families.
Previous experience with recruiting subjects, with an understanding of the ethical and technical conduct of research preferred.
Excellent English communication skills (oral and written).
Bilingual candidate preferred, not required, fluent in spoken and written English, Spanish, and/or Haitian Creole.
Cultural sensitivity and comfort with a wide range of social, racial and ethnic populations.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (i.e. MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook) and web browsers. Experience with statistical software a plus.

cond_0255.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team.

Provides assistance in the development of reports, presentations, and data analysis. Assists in data collection and provides feedback on study's progress. Recruits subjects to participate in the study by using approved methodologies. Conducts the enrollment of study participants, including explaining research procedures, and obtaining informed consent of subjects and/or their families. Schedules appointments of study participants; conducts reminder phone calls and/or sends mailouts. Reviews the data collection forms for each enrollee for completion and quality; checks work of junior staff performing data entry to ensure timely and accurate entry. Provides technical guidance to junior staff. Conducts literature searches. Assists Investigators with manuscript and presentation preparation and research.

Performs office-related duties such as answering phones, picking up and delivering mail, ordering and distributing office supplies, handling faxes, scanning, filing, photocopying, collating materials, maintaining the update of policy manuals, etc. Perform administrative duties associated with the study's Data Monitoring and Safety Board, tracking and reporting adverse events and collecting data specified by the DSMB. Responsible for the administrative aspects of the research study, including: managing program records and handling communication needs of the program. Prepares and maintains Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals and correspondence, including amendments and renewals as necessary. Obtains and distributes payment vouchers for participant reimbursements/participation.
